scientific_integrity: The proof establishes closedness via stop-loss continuity and density via two explicitly mean-preserving perturbations, including a separate diagonal case, followed by exact-mean smooth positive-density approximation. The finite rational script is only a check of algebraic examples, not an infinite topological certificate.
scientific_limitations: The result uses the weak topology of all laws on a compact interval with fixed interior mean; it does not establish probabilistic prevalence or strong C^k-density topology claims. At an endpoint mean the fiber is a singleton and the conclusion fails. An older equivalent category statement under fixed-barycenter, majorization, or stop-loss terminology remains possible.
title: Generic convex-order incomparability within every prescribed-mean fiber
